newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Two dead, 25 sick in Vietnam water poisoning case.
newsitem.headline: Two dead, 25 sick in Vietnam water poisoning case.

text.p: Two young children died and 25 adults fell sick in the central Vietnam ese province of Phu Yen after drinking contaminated water, a local health official said on Monday.
He said a four-month-old infant and a one-year-old child died, and 25 adults were stricken with severe diarrhoea after a three-day festival in their ethnic minority village.
"The drinking water quality was very poor because the local people are not aware of water treatment methods," he said.
He denied a newspaper report that the people were poisoned by eating the flesh of diseased cows.
